website_online.description: Deploy the existing API qualification website and make the configured domain reachable over HTTPS.

engineering_task.description: Read a trusted engineering specification from the codex-dispatch branch and implement it in a dedicated codex/* branch.

notes: The worker rejects unknown task types.
The worker rejects forbidden payload fields.
Engineering task text is stored in an allowlisted repository task-spec path rather than accepted as an arbitrary command payload.
The worker constructs the local Codex instruction from trusted templates.
Secrets may only be used locally by reference and must never be written back to GitHub.
Engineering tasks may create a branch, commit, push, test, and open a PR, but must never merge or force-push.
